questions.topic: PrepLadder · 29.⁠Renal Tumors and Renal Congenital Abnormalities
questions.stem: A 55-year-old male presents with painless hematuria and weight loss over the past six months. CECT reveals a 9 cm enhancing mass in the right kidney, with evidence of invasion into the renal vein. Histopathology shows cells with clear cytoplasm and a delicate network of vasculature. Which of the following is the most likely variant of renal cell carcinoma?
